stock.description: Mech-Mind Robotics Technologies Co., Ltd. develops and provides core technologies and products for robotics, including 3D vision systems, dexterous robotic hands, and large language models for robotic perception, understanding, and decision-making in Chinese Mainland, Japan, South Korea, the United States, Canada and Europe. The company offers the mech-eye series of industrial and 3D cameras for high-precision, high-speed acquisition of three-dimensional information, and the mech-hand dexterous robotic hand for flexible object manipulation in complex tasks. It provides the mech-gpt multimodal large model to support robotic learning, understanding, reasoning, and decision-making, enabling robots to comprehend natural language instructions and operate in complex environments. The company's camera products, such as the mech-eye LNX series, deliver high-resolution and high-speed scanning for detailed measurement and imaging, with technologies based on proprietary optical and AI imaging. These products and solutions are designed for integration with various types of robots across industrial and service applications. The company serves clients in industrial manufacturing, logistics, home sectors, electronics, automotive, photovoltaic industries, and research and educational institutions. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Hebei, China.
